item.title: Singing St. Louis activists push back on ICE
item.description: A group of St. Louisans hope to counter the actions of Immigration and Customs Enforcement by singing. Singing Resistance STL is the new St. Louis chapter of a national movement begun in Minneapolis after ICE agents swarmed the city. item.title: Ask George: What is jack salmon, and is it a St. Louis thing?
item.description: When I was a youngster, I remember marveling at the sight of jack salmon, a skinny, foot-long, batter-fried, bone-in/tail-on fin fish sitting in a grocery store hot case along with a dozen near-similar specimens…and swearing I’d never eat one.
